title: Other violinists and clarinetists he knew
summary: He names a Baton Rouge violinist and a small E-flat clarinetist, and then Happy Goldston as the drummer who played with him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah. Fine. Yeah. Can you tell us, do you remember any of the old time violin players? Anybody else that played violin when you were young? Yeah, no fella. In the city here?
No, not in the city, but I know a fella. Used to play in the Baton Rouge band. I don't know what I think his name was. Tyner. Turner. Oh.

That was up in Baton Rouge. Baton Rouge, yeah. Was that the name of the, was he the leader of the band? Yeah, that's right. Was it his band? Yeah, his band. He'd stomp off, huh? Yeah. Do you remember any other clarinet players down here besides Dodds that you heard?
I heard that Uricoband, that player. Yeah. Yeah, he plays too. But then he carried that little short with the way up or... Little E flat clarinet. Yeah. How's that?

We were talking yesterday. Yeah. That was just lately you heard that, you mean? Well, I tell you, I tell you a fella play in the band with him. He lived right there in the last, last gate, uh, Arnt Fence. That's his home there. His name was, he's a drummer. His name is... Oh, uh, Happy, uh... Happy, yeah. Goldston. Oh, Goldston, yeah.
